author: ValWood
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**


GO:0006357 | regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II | IEA with ARBA00028137

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC30.02c

* **Description of issue**

Annotation .
Appears to come from

involved in | regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II |   | IGI with ELP3 | SGD | 2013-08-07 | Petrakis TG, et al. (2005) PMID:15772087

But this is just a genetic interaction (not all GI proteins are in the same pathway), so presumably, these annotations weren't made for a GI that demonstrated that both genes were involved in transcription.

Also, ELP3 is no longer annotated to, or considered to be directly involved in transcription.

this annotation seems to based only on growth phenotypes, and acetylation phenotypes

@edwong57  could you check this primary annotation, I only did a quick glance, thanks

author: Antonialock
body: I removed the rice and arabidopsis annotations to this term. I have queried the cerevisiae annotation, but the ARBA should disappear since there is only one remaining manual annotation to the term.
